verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with API-key and token authorization, a Power-Up Skeleton starter project, and a third-party React/TypeScript sample, but nothing shows an official SDK or client library. A raw REST API and a starter template are developer building blocks, not official SDKs, and the third-party sample is not first-party. The MCP server belongs to a separate story, so none of this earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
